text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, Trainer and 
Transcend visited Niigata to enter the 
Leopard Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to Transcend's intel, a wealthy 
oil baron from Dubai has arrived in the 
spectator seats.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she catches someone's eye, she might 
receive an invitation to a GⅠ race in 
Dubai. Even if not, it's also a chance for 
her to build up her courage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Will she catch the eye of the wealthy 
elites— With a thrilling sense of tension, 
Transcend heads into the Leopard Stakes.
